body:
These are just a few of the causes Jahana had championed in 2025 — and this important work will continue in 2026. | | Team, The past year has been full of chaos caused by Donald Trump and the Republican-controlled Congress. That has not stopped Jahana from delivering for families across the country and stopping the damage. At the beginning of the year, Congresswoman Hayes [joined a bipartisan town hall on CNN](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/122398315/592459201/742461579?refcode=AU_JH_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20251231_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODk4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNjM4OWU1OC05NmU2LWYwMTEtODE5NS0wMDBkM2ExZDU4YWEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-zXkOuBEGffUvwJRFtwuZewxAPOa2_v5I1WIUjSG9SE=&emci=39311b52-96e6-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&emdi=16389e58-96e6-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&ceid=15529135), standing up to her GOP colleagues and the Trump administration. She responded to questions from voters and powerfully rebuked the damage caused by Elon Musk and DOGE. When the Trump admin cut nearly _$200 billion_ in food assistance, leaving families and farmers to scramble to pick up the pieces, Jahana fought back. [She introduced the _Restoring Food Security for American Families and Farmers Act of 2025_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/122398316/592459202/-1051454827?refcode=AU_JH_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20251231_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODk4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNjM4OWU1OC05NmU2LWYwMTEtODE5NS0wMDBkM2ExZDU4YWEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-zXkOuBEGffUvwJRFtwuZewxAPOa2_v5I1WIUjSG9SE=&emci=39311b52-96e6-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&emdi=16389e58-96e6-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&ceid=15529135), which would reverse the harmful cuts that the Trump administration made to SNAP. As an educator and a member of the House Education Committee, Jahana has been a leading voice for our students and teachers. She has introduced legislation to protect the Department of Education and feed our children in school. The Congresswoman wants to keep our communities safe from the scourge of gun violence. She is a leading voice on this issue:
* She introduced the [_School Violence Prevention Act_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/122398317/592459203/-1194667693?refcode=AU_JH_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20251231_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODk4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNjM4OWU1OC05NmU2LWYwMTEtODE5NS0wMDBkM2ExZDU4YWEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-zXkOuBEGffUvwJRFtwuZewxAPOa2_v5I1WIUjSG9SE=&emci=39311b52-96e6-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&emdi=16389e58-96e6-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&ceid=15529135) to bolster resources to eliminate gun violence in schools.
* She has pushed for Republican leaders, including Speaker Mike Johnson, to address the gun violence epidemic.
* She introduced the [_Safer Neighborhoods Gun Buyback Act_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/122398318/592459204/-943804241?refcode=AU_JH_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20251231_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODk4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNjM4OWU1OC05NmU2LWYwMTEtODE5NS0wMDBkM2ExZDU4YWEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-zXkOuBEGffUvwJRFtwuZewxAPOa2_v5I1WIUjSG9SE=&emci=39311b52-96e6-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&emdi=16389e58-96e6-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&ceid=15529135) to establish state and local gun buyback programs to help prevent gun violence, remove unwanted firearms from communities nationwide, and empower local safety efforts.

When Republicans failed to protect affordable health care, she called them out on the House floor. This failure will have devastating consequences for millions of Americans who rely on the marketplace for affordable health coverage, and _Jahana is intent on restoring those credits_. The Congresswoman also spoke with the [CT Mirror during the Republican government shutdown.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/122398319/592459205/-223560048?refcode=AU_JH_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20251231_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODk4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNjM4OWU1OC05NmU2LWYwMTEtODE5NS0wMDBkM2ExZDU4YWEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-zXkOuBEGffUvwJRFtwuZewxAPOa2_v5I1WIUjSG9SE=&emci=39311b52-96e6-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&emdi=16389e58-96e6-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&ceid=15529135) At a time when many families faced uncertainty about whether they would receive SNAP benefits or go back to work, Jahana gave families the information they needed to get through the shutdown. Her bipartisan _Caring for Survivors Act_ provides long-needed updates to benefits for surviving family members after the service-related death of a loved one. She will not stop until these survivors and all veterans get the full benefits they deserve. **These are just _a few_ of the causes Jahana had championed in 2025 — and this important work will continue in 2026.** Republicans will continue to play games with health care and food assistance, all to satisfy Trump’s billionaire agenda. **[That is why we need to continue supporting Jahana for the fights ahead. If you are with us in this work, will you pitch in before our end-of-year fundraising deadline?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/122398320/592459206/-1546761245?refcode=AU_JH_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20251231_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODk4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNjM4OWU1OC05NmU2LWYwMTEtODE5NS0wMDBkM2ExZDU4YWEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-zXkOuBEGffUvwJRFtwuZewxAPOa2_v5I1WIUjSG9SE=)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [$10 →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/122398321/592459207/-1546761245?express_lane=true&amount=10&refcode=AU_JH_FR_GEN_EOQ_AC_20251231_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82ODk4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIxNjM4OWU1OC05NmU2LWYwMTEtODE5NS0wMDBkM2ExZDU4YWEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-zXkOuBEGffUvwJRFtwuZewxAPOa2_v5I1WIUjSG9SE=)

Friend — With just hours to go until our end-of-year FEC filing deadline, I am counting on supporters like YOU today. **Please, read on just a little bit more.**
I announced I was running for reelection back in April, and I was excited to continue advancing this grassroots movement alongside all of you.
But within weeks, AIPAC was already running polls in my district, testing the waters on a corporate-backed, pro-Israel candidate who could challenge me. A few months later, a DNC member jumped into the race to defeat me.
The truth is, we have no idea what’s coming our way next year. There’s still plenty of time for more challengers to enter this race and receive millions in support from outside spenders and special interests.
So, this FEC deadline isn’t just any deadline. This is our chance to prove to AIPAC, the media, and the entire political establishment that our campaign is stronger than ever.
**But with little time left, we are still behind on our fundraising goals.**
And if we fall short, we’ll send the opposite message: that this campaign isn’t as strong as it once was. That this campaign is vulnerable to attacks from corporate PACs, special interests, and even Trump and the entire far-right.
We can’t have that.
**[So please: Chip in $10 or whatever you can afford before my FEC filing deadline hits at midnight. Every Texas Legislature seat has a Democrat on the ticket. Normal people like you and I are stepping up and saying, “Enough”. I never thought I’d see momentum like this at home, and yet, you all have continued to show up time and time again. I’m asking you to show up again today. I know you’ve received tons of fundraising asks today (believe me, I have too), but I’m here to ask you to chip in today to help me win the **March 3rd primary**. If you’ve been waiting for the right time to give, it’s now. **$16** covers postage to get my name in front of 20 more voters. **$35** fills up my tank to drive across all 13 counties in our district. **$50** pays for a 4'x4' sign at a high traffic intersection. I just got out of a meeting that left me absolutely shaken. Leadership shared something with me – something devastating – and I can’t talk about it openly.

name: Chris Brooks, LCV
subject: My final ask of 2025, Peter: please chip in before midnight tonight
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTMzNDU3NzYS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjM2MDI4ODEwOQS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/- We’re running out of time, Peter. Hundreds of people from around the country have stepped up today for Giving Tuesday, but we’re still running short of the 1,000 members we need to unlock an additional $100,000 for our work before midnight tonight. And with the Trump administration accelerating some of the most extreme anti-environment, pro-polluter attacks in modern history,falling short is simply not an option. We’re asking you, Peter: will you renew your LCV membership right now while membership is only $5 to help us unlock an additional $100,000 to oppose the Trump administration’s attempts to exploit our public lands and roll back climate progress? https://links.messages.lcv. This isn’t just about hitting a number. It’s about having the resources we need to challenge these increasingly reckless orders and attempts to shred environmental safeguards — and stop the polluter handouts that Trump and his allies are fast-tracking. RENEW YOUR MEMBERSHIP >> https://links.messages.lcv. Every single person who steps up today is critical to our efforts — here’s why this Giving Tuesday is so important: Trump is trying to erase the scientific and legal foundation of climate action. By dismantling the Endangerment Finding, which affirms that greenhouse gas emissions harm our health and welfare, Trump’s EPA would hand fossil fuel companies a free pass to spew climate pollution into our air. He’s also ending the program that required big polluters to report their pollution, making it nearly impossible to track what they’re spewing or hold them accountable.
Decades of established pollution protections are being peeled away. More than a dozen rules that keep toxic pollution out of the air we breathe and water we drink to protect our health are on the chopping block, tossed aside to allow fossil fueled power plants to cut corners and shift the burden of their damage onto our communities.
The Trump administration is giving away the Arctic to corporate polluters, working to allow more drilling in one of the planet’s last intact ecosystems. Mining roads carved through national parks and preserves. Fire-sale auctions in critical ecosystems. Hundreds of millions of acres of U.S. waters off Alaska potentially opened to drilling. It could do irreparable damage to wildlife, our climate, and Alaska Native communities. We’re working every day with our 30 state affiliates, organizing on the ground, exposing backroom deals and corruption, rallying voters, and defending the treasured and unique places that define our country. But meeting this moment requires resources — especially as we go up against big polluters and fossil fuel opponents. This $100,000 match challenge, and how many people step up this Giving Tuesday, will determine how hard we can push back. Peter, your renewal right now powers our work to protect people and the planet. Will you renew before MIDNIGHT TONIGHT to help keep this movement strong when it matters most? $5 is all it takes. https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/DzpWMV~q_ Every contribution brings us closer. And the clock is ticking. Thanks for standing with us, Chris Brooks

name: Team Weber
subject: 2025 was not a quiet year for elections
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Shirley Weber for Secretary of State 2026
body:
https://drshirleyweber.com/?utm_source=email%20wrapper&utm_medium=email%20wrapper&utm_campaign=email%20wrapper [https://drshirleyweber.com/?utm_source=email%20wrapper&utm_medium=email%20wrapper&utm_campaign=email%20wrapper]
Hey there,

Before we enter the new year, we wanted to take a moment to reflect on what this team has been able to accomplish together, and to look at what’s ahead of us.

Let’s face it: This was NOT a quiet year for our elections.

Californians showed up for a statewide special election under Proposition 50, and the Secretary of State’s office worked across counties to ensure voters had clear information, accessible ballots, and confidence that their votes would be counted fairly and transparently. That process mattered greatly — and it worked .

At the same time, California faced growing political pressure from outside the state. When the federal government sought access to sensitive California voter data, Dr. Weber stood firm in defense of voter privacy and the integrity of our elections, making clear that voter information should never be used as a political tool.

As we look ahead to 2026, we know the challenges leading up to Election Day will continue. But so will our resolve.

Before the year comes to an end, we’re asking you to help us carry this work forward. Will you make a year-end contribution today to support Dr. Weber and help protect California’s democracy in the year ahead? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rd_weber_2512_email?refcode=251231-web-em-eoyfundr]

Contribute » https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rd_weber_2512_email?refcode=251231-web-em-eoyfundr

The truth is: Democracy doesn’t just happen. It survives because of the people who choose to stay involved, do their civic duty, and defend the principles that make our freedoms possible.

Friend: Thanks to people like you, we are making sure that our democracy doesn’t just survive, that it thrives.

Sometimes, it’s easy to forget what’s at the core of our pro-democracy work due to all the political gamesmanship and vicious attacks from Donald Trump and other far-right Republicans.

But no matter what attacks came, no matter how much misinformation was spread, Dr. Weber fought back in the best way possible: through impactful actions and leadership.

* She’s defended voter privacy
* She expanded voting rights to include people on parole and ensured that every Californian has access to and awareness of their right to vote
* She’s consistently advocated for an election system that removes barriers to the ballot
* She runs one of the most accessible and transparent election departments in the U.S.
* She protects election workers from violence by reaching across the aisle to defend nonpartisan staff, and works with local law enforcement to monitor threats
* She informs voters throughout the participation process, making vote-by-mail deadlines clear, ensuring processes for tracking ballots, and creating processes that streamline in-person voting

Dr. Weber’s commitment to the very principles that make our democracy strong is rooted in a lifetime of public service and a deep belief that every Californian deserves a voice. And it’s because of supporters like you that this work continues.

Democracy doesn’t protect itself. It requires leaders who are willing to do the work, stand their ground, and put voters first.

Your support helps ensure California continues to have that kind of leadership — will you contribute towards our final end-of-year fundraising push before midnight tonight? >> https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rd_weber_2511_email?refcode=251231-web-em-eoyfundr

Thank you for being a part of Team Weber, and for believing in a democracy that works for every Californian and beyond.

Happy New Year from all of us here at Team Weber!

In service and solidarity,
Team Weber

Derek,

As we prepare to close the book on 2025, we’ve been doing a lot of reflecting.
We faced a political landscape that tested our resolve and forced us to fight harder than ever for our values. Here in Pennsylvania, we didn't just hold the line, we pushed back. We have so much to be proud of. Because you showed up and helped with donations and with your time, we:
**Swept the Statewide Courts** : We successfully retained all three Democratic Supreme Court justices – Christine Donohue, Kevin Dougherty, and David Wecht – protecting the last line of defense for our voting rights and reproductive freedoms against MAGA extremists.

**Flipped Key Counties** : We saw a "Blue Wave" in critical bellwethers, winning the County Executive races in Erie and Northampton by historic margins. We are winning back the voters we need to take back the state.

**Organized Everywhere** : From electing the first openly transgender mayor in Downingtown to winning every county seat up for grabs in Bucks County, we are building power in every corner of the state.
We’ve proven that our coalition is resilient, diverse, and unwilling to back down when the stakes are highest. This is the foundation for our comeback.

The 2026 midterms are the next milestone. This is our opportunity to restore balance, protect our democracy, and elect leaders who actually fight for working families, the climate, and our fundamental freedoms.
We have the vision. We have the candidates. Now, we just need the resources to hit the ground running on January 1st.

Peter,
It’s Dan Helmer. I’m a West Point graduate, Iraq and Afghanistan veteran, and a member of the Virginia House of Delegates. I also serve as Campaigns Chair for the Virginia House Democratic Caucus, where I helped lead one of the most historic wins in modern Virginia politics this past November.
With Get Out The Vote (GOTV PAC) and supporters like you, we didn’t just win races, we reshaped Virginia.
Together, we:
* Flipped 13 seats and delivered a 64-seat Democratic House majority — our largest since 1987
* Won the governor’s mansion by electing Abigail Spanberger
* Ended a generation of GOP leadership in Richmond
Now, we have to do it again.
On January 6, there’s a special election to fill Lt. Gov.-Elect Ghazala Hashmi’s Senate seat. If we lose, the Senate falls to a 20–20 tie, grinding progress to a halt and blocking constitutional amendments to protect abortion rights, fair maps, and more.
If we show up, we win. If we don’t, we lose momentum.
That’s why I’m asking you to chip in to Get Out The Vote PAC today so they can make the voter contact investments needed to win this special election.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gotv-sp-2025?refcode=em12312025 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gotv-sp-2025?refcode=em12312025]
We know what works. We’ve done it before. Now we have to do it again.
Warm regards,
Dan Helmer

Member, Virginia House of Delegates

body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/122403477/592473222/-2089736527?refcode=em-12.31.25-all-2-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOTZmYzE5Yy1hMWU2LWYwMTEtODE5NS0wMDBkM2ExZDU4YWEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=77uXp-fMfTWAY9_9WgnSzefNYAVTnkhwZEC5wbk0H04=)
Hi Peter,
It’s Rebecca. As the year comes to a close, I just wanted to take a moment (in between shoveling snow and taking time with family and friends) to thank you from the bottom of my heart.
2025 was a big year. In March, I made the decision to step back into this race, because I believe so deeply that western Wisconsin deserves better. I’ve waited tables, listened to neighbors, and knocked doors in communities where people are just trying to get by and give their kids a better future. And I’ve seen, again and again, that the strength of this campaign is in the people who show up, give what they can, and believe in something better.
Together, we’ve come incredibly far. We’re polling neck and neck with Derrick Van Orden. We’re outraising expectations. And we’re doing it all with a grassroots team that’s growing stronger every day.
I’m proud of what we’ve built together. This campaign is backed by folks like you: teachers, farmers, nurses, students, parents, retirees. Many have pitched in time, resources, and heart to help us build something powerful.
If you’re in a place to chip in before the year ends, it would mean a lot. Every donation (no matter the size) helps us keep building on the momentum we’ve worked so hard for. And if now’s not the time, I still can’t thank you enough for being part of this campaign.
Here’s a good link for that: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cooke-q4-2025](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/122403478/592473223/-2089736527?refcode=em-12.31.25-all-2-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85MzUwMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkOTZmYzE5Yy1hMWU2LWYwMTEtODE5NS0wMDBkM2ExZDU4YWEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=77uXp-fMfTWAY9_9WgnSzefNYAVTnkhwZEC5wbk0H04=)**
I know the road ahead won’t be easy. But I also know we’re building a movement that can win, and more importantly, can govern with compassion, grit, and purpose.
So thank you. For believing in this campaign. For standing with me. And for helping us fight for a future that puts working people first.
Wishing you a safe and joyful start to the new year.
With gratitude,
Rebecca

Dear Peter,
---
Thank you for joining our campaign! Running for Congress was never something I planned, but I am deeply frustrated by the current state of our country—the constant attacks on our democracy and institutions, and our reckless approach to war. * **Healthcare is a universal right** , not a privilege, and people have guaranteed access to abortion and full reproductive rights.
* **Every job pays a living wage** , and families benefit from universal daycare.
* **Public education is fully funded** , and all children have access to early education.
* **Agricultural policy incentivizes conservation** , dramatically reduces taxpayer costs, and requires big agribusiness to pay the farmers' real price for raw goods.

Hey Peter, I hope all is well and you had a great holiday season!

I just got off a call with our finance team for our final check-in of the year and honestly, I’m really worried. _**We’re still $9,900 short of our critical End of Year goal and we only have 5 hours to make up the difference.**_

This is the LAST public filing deadline before 2026. We’re putting every last penny into ramping up our organizing and voter turnout efforts ASAP. And for good reason.

The earlier we get a jump on the work in the new year, the more Democratic voters we’ll bring into our movement to keep me in Congress and end Republican extremists’ stranglehold on Florida.

**Everyone’s waiting to see if our grassroots strength can hold up into 2026 – including the fascists who are desperately hoping we’ll fail and lose the momentum we need to compete against them. But I refuse to let that happen.**

Everything we raise now will determine whether we can keep up the fight to end gun violence, protect abortion access, advocate for environmental justice, and bring the change necessary to lead us to a brighter future in Florida and across the country.

Peter, this is your last chance in 2025 to make an impact and fuel our movement before this critical deadline, which is why I’m personally asking you to chip in right now.

Here’s a personalized link to donate $27, or whatever you can before 2026.
